svg.title: Playable Signal — 56 contributions across 7 active days
svg.desc: Animated contribution grid for @Arjun07707, 2025-11-23 to 2026-11-28. A ship sweeps across the year, firing at the 7 days with contributions; each hit cell pulses and clears, then the year begins again.

g.text: public data · one sweep = one year
